p1_password.name: Literal password
p1_password.description: Direct string comparison; the simplest reference case.

p2_license.name: Literal license key
p2_license.description: Direct license-key comparison; a second strcmp reference control.

p3_pin.name: Numeric PIN
p3_pin.description: Strict numeric parsing and comparison; strings is not a complete test for numeric secrets.

p4_activation.name: Activation code
p4_activation.description: Directly checks the ACT- prefix, year 2026, and READY suffix; no encoding or secret reconstruction.

p5_access.name: Staff access code
p5_access.description: Checks the STAFF:code format and literal ENTRY-42 code; no XOR or pre-applied hiding.

p6_staged.name: Segmented license
p6_staged.description: Directly checks LAB-, 3749, and -KQ segments; no equations used to hide the answer.
